subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should an omitted camera-facing parameter remain the documented front-camera default, or become an iOS user-preference default for all agent and direct node capture paths?
rationale: The PR changes one iOS fallback while the established agent path explicitly supplies front, so a mechanical repair cannot safely choose the public cross-entry-point contract.

options.title: Make the iOS preference authoritative
options.body: Preserve the feature by carrying an omitted facing through the normal agent capture path, documenting the iOS-specific default, and validating both explicit and omitted requests.

options.title: Preserve the front-default contract
options.body: Keep omitted facing fixed to front and redesign the camera flip as an explicit, separately modeled capture choice rather than silently changing node invocation semantics.

recommendation.title: Make the iOS preference authoritative
recommendation.body: Preserve the feature by carrying an omitted facing through the normal agent capture path, documenting the iOS-specific default, and validating both explicit and omitted requests.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed iOS Talk behavior and its implementation are concentrated in this PR’s authored commits.
